---
title: Watermark colour that injects Typst
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    watermark:
      text: DRAFT
      colour: 'red); #panic("x"'
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        errors: strict
    typst:
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: '\[typst-extras\] watermark: unsupported colour'
---

Some text.
